explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/654, which notes that the [Fe26] construction (points on two lines) does not settle the (1−o(1))n question for points in general position. The statement is that question with InGeneralPosition (no three collinear, no four concyclic): ∀ ε > 0, eventually every such n-set has a point with > (1−ε)n distinct distances. Faithful.
